crop.notes: Clipping covers only the first column of the Thurston story and runs into the St. Bernard Dollar Store ad (crops 5-6). The article continues for two more columns on the page; the continuation is not in the clipping.

ocr.notes: Mostly readable with scattered errors; the transcript also includes the ad text at the end. The Allen passage is transcribed correctly.

title.suggested: Obituary of rough-and-tumble fighter Sherman Thurston mentions Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat recalled the life of rough-and-tumble fighter Sherman Thurston, who died in Chicago. It said he had wrongly been written up as Tom Allen's trainer and that Allen was always afraid of him.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, October 23, 1887, page 20.

facts.fact: The Globe-Democrat denied reports that rough-and-tumble fighter Sherman Thurston had been Allen's trainer, saying Allen was always afraid of him

notes: The crop misses the article's continuation in the next two columns, which may mention Allen again; a recrop is needed to check.
